items.title: The Yorkshire Wildlife Park tiger
items.summary: A man climbed into the tiger enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in Doncaster and was killed by Altai, a five-year-old Amur tiger, and footage of him sitting in the grass in front of the tiger spread everywhere. X split between "the tiger should have been shot immediately" and people defending the park and the tiger, and a post of the next day's news that Altai would not be put down got 199K likes. The man was later named as William Chapman, 23, whose family said he had a significant mental illness.
